rules.authorization_header: no hit when an `Authorization:` header with scheme Bearer or Basic (case-insensitive) carries only a placeholder up to the next blank, backtick, quote, comma, semicolon or `)`: `…`, `...`, `<name>` (no angle bracket inside), `[REDACTED` up to the next `]` on the line, 3+ of x/X only, `$NAME`, `${…}`, `{name}`, or a lowercase token-type prefix ending in `_` elided with `…`/`...` (`hive_p_…`); any other value (`sk_live_51H…`, a base64 token) hits as before
rules.card: no hit for a card candidate whose digits (separators ignored) equal one of Stripe's documented test card numbers by brand (stripe.com/docs/testing: the 17 numbers listed in `cases` with hit false); compared exactly, no prefix rule; every other Luhn-valid card hits as before
rules.digest_tokens: no generic secret hit (generic_api_key, high_entropy_secret, url_encoded_secret and their redaction rules) for a token that is exactly `ed25519-` + 32, or `sha256:`, `blake3:`, `sha256-` + 64 lowercase hex, bounded by no character of [A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]; other lengths, uppercase hex or extra characters hit as before
rules.redaction_marker: no masked-in-store hit for a redaction marker `[REDACTED` up to its `]` on the same line when it sits inside a one-line backtick code span (docs showing the marker format); outside a code span the marker still refuses the text
rules.detector: authorization_header, card, high_entropy_secret (the generic key/value family), redaction_marker (the masked-in-store check); `source` marks a dogfood line the whole screen must pass
